notes.title: v1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
After a month of Fenced In being on the steam store, it's officially time to bring it out of early access and into a proper game!

V1.0 includes a few tweaks to the way arcade mode counts down your time remaining, but otherwise the rest of the game was fairly bug-free, so this is more of a neccesity of getting the game out of early access.

As always, if you have any feedback or bugs, please don't hesitate to let me know!

Thank you for playing Fenced In!

notes.title: v0.4.3
notes.notes:
This update includes a few fixes:

- Fixed an edge case where a combination wouldn't register
- Fixed Combination pop up being white - it'll now stand out more to show the player they've found a new combination

notes.title: v0.4.2
notes.notes:
This build fixes the following:

- Fixed a bug on the start screen where trees will despawn before they're meant to (affecting ultrawide monitor players)
- Fixed a bug on the game over screen where text didn't display correctly

If you have any other issues, please don't hesitate to let me know!

notes.title: Fenced In is out now!
notes.notes:
[p]Fenced in is out now on all platforms!

The game is still classed as Early Access as I'll be updating some of the gameplay based on feedback from the community, otherwise all game modes are already present (Arcade, Release, Chameleon, Online) complete with Steam leaderboards for all game modes.[/p][p]Thank you for your time, and I hope you enjoy the game I've put some serious effort into![/p][p][/p][p]The release comes with the following features:[/p][list][*][p]Available on all platforms (Mac, Windows, Linux, Steam Deck)[/p][/*][*][p]4 Game Modes[/p][/*][*][p]Cute Pixel Artwork[/p][/*][*][p]Complete (Awesome) Soundtrack[/p][/*][*][p]Stats Tracking (Steam and in-game)[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Leaderboards[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Cloud Save sync across all platforms[/p][/*][*][p]Realtime button remapping on all supported controllers (Steam Deck Controller, Xbox, Playstation, Switch Controller)[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, any feedback or discussion is greatly appreciated![/p][p]Thank you for checking out, and supporting, Fenced In![/p]

notes.title: An update on Steam Deck compatibility
notes.notes:
Just a quick heads up that throughout all development of the game, Steam Deck has been the primary platform that has been worked on. Cross platform cloud saves are confirmed to work across all platforms, so all high scores, and stats of what you've done in the game will carry across all platforms, whether you're out and about on the Steam Deck, or at home on your PC or Mac!

We'll need to wait a little bit longer for the game to be released, but once it is, we should get a verified badge with no issues - the whole game has cross input support for any device you decide to use.
